title: iFixIt - Workshop Management Platform
description: A comprehensive web and mobile platform for automotive workshop management, featuring real-time location tracking, appointment scheduling, and complete service lifecycle management.
overview_p1: iFixIt is a full-stack solution designed to modernize automotive workshop operations. The platform connects customers, technicians, and workshop managers through intuitive web and mobile interfaces.
overview_p2: The system includes real-time location tracking for mobile technicians, intelligent appointment scheduling, comprehensive service management, and automated customer communications.
overview_p3: Built with modern technologies and best practices, the platform demonstrates proficiency in full-stack development and system architecture.
features: Real-time location tracking for mobile technicians

challenges.title: Real-time Tracking
challenges.description: Implemented efficient real-time location tracking for field technicians with minimal battery impact and accurate positioning.

challenges.title: Smart Scheduling
challenges.description: Developed an intelligent scheduling system that optimizes routes and minimizes travel time between appointments.

challenges.title: Service Management
challenges.description: Created a comprehensive service management system handling the complete lifecycle from request to completion.

automation_subtitle: Designed for workshops and agencies looking to optimize vehicle registration and maintenance tracking
automation_search_desc: Locate any vehicle in seconds. Access complete history, current status, and all relevant information by simply entering the license plate.
automation_status_desc: Keep your customers informed. Status system that notifies maintenance progress and when they can pick up their vehicle.
automation_images_desc: Document every detail with photos. Organize and store images of the vehicle's condition before, during, and after service.
automation_comments_desc: Record observations, pre-existing damage, and important communications for each vehicle.
automation_mobile_desc: Native iOS and Android app for customers to browse nearby workshops, check their vehicle status, and receive real-time notifications.
automation_responsive_desc: Works seamlessly on any device: PC, tablet, or smartphone.
